title: testmap does not select test_layout.py when a _tools module changes
goal: testmap.py select maps a change to any _tools/*.py to _tools/test_layout.py, which reads every module by glob, so the sync gate's changed-tests run catches a new facade import or underscore reach; test_testmap.py plants a module change and sees test_layout.py selected

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/testmap.py','select','--paths','_tools/kbfacts.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;assert '_tools/test_layout.py' in o,'test_layout.py not selected for a _tools module change'
